homeScreen.title: Add to Home Screen
homeScreen.body: Open this page in Safari. Tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen". iPhone and iPad need iOS / iPadOS 16.4 or newer.

openIcon.title: Open from the icon
openIcon.body: Close Safari and open the app from its icon on the Home Screen.

notifications.title: Turn on notifications
notifications.body: Tap "Turn on notifications" and choose Allow.

sound.title: Turn on sound
sound.body: Tap "Turn on sound" once each time you open the app. Keep the phone volume up and the silent switch off.

telegram.title: Connect Telegram (family)
telegram.body: In Settings, tap "Connect Telegram", then press Start in Telegram.
